constraint reservations.reservations_desk_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (desk_id) REFERENCES desks(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraint reservations.reservations_desk_no_overlap EXCLUDE USING gist (desk_id WITH =, tstzrange(starts_at, ends_at) WITH &&) WHERE (((desk_id IS NOT NULL) AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['reserved'::text, 'checked_in'::text]))))
constraint reservations.reservations_level_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (level_id) REFERENCES levels(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraint reservations.reservations_level_no_overlap EXCLUDE USING gist (level_id WITH =, tstzrange(starts_at, ends_at) WITH &&) WHERE (((level_id IS NOT NULL) AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['reserved'::text, 'checked_in'::text]))))
constraint reservations.reservations_member_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (member_id) REFERENCES members(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraint reservations.reservations_member_id_same_workspace FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id, member_id) REFERENCES members(workspace_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraint reservations.reservations_office_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (office_id) REFERENCES offices(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraint reservations.reservations_office_no_overlap EXCLUDE USING gist (office_id WITH =, tstzrange(starts_at, ends_at) WITH &&) WHERE (((status = ANY (ARRAY['reserved'::text, 'checked_in'::text])) AND (office_id IS NOT NULL)))
constraint reservations.reservations_one_target CHECK ((((((
CASE
    WHEN (seat_id IS NULL) THEN 0
    ELSE 1
END +
CASE
    WHEN (desk_id IS NULL) THEN 0
    ELSE 1
END) +
CASE
    WHEN (office_id IS NULL) THEN 0
    ELSE 1
END) +
CASE
    WHEN (level_id IS NULL) THEN 0
    ELSE 1
END) = 1) OR ((seat_id IS NULL) AND (desk_id IS NULL) AND (office_id IS NULL) AND (level_id IS NULL) AND (space_label IS NOT NULL))))
constraint reservations.reservations_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
constraint reservations.reservations_seat_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (seat_id) REFERENCES seats(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraint reservations.reservations_seat_no_overlap EXCLUDE USING gist (seat_id WITH =, tstzrange(starts_at, ends_at) WITH &&) WHERE (((status = ANY (ARRAY['reserved'::text, 'checked_in'::text])) AND (seat_id IS NOT NULL)))

constraint reservations.reservations_status_check CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['reserved'::text, 'checked_in'::text, 'completed'::text, 'cancelled'::text, 'released'::text])))
constraint reservations.reservations_time_valid CHECK ((ends_at > starts_at))
constraint reservations.reservations_workspace_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id) REFERENCES workspaces(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

    ELSE 0

    ELSE 0
END) +

    WHEN (decimal_value IS NOT NULL) THEN 1
    ELSE 0
END) +

    WHEN (date_value IS NOT NULL) THEN 1
    ELSE 0
END) +

    WHEN (boolean_value IS NOT NULL) THEN 1
    ELSE 0
